name: Drowned Reef
summary: Ships bound for Faldir's Cove risk the Drowned Reef off Arathi's southern coast. Ancient ruins lie below, where Daggerspine naga seem able to command the bay's tides.

sections.title: A Graveyard of Ships
sections.body: Beyond the hidden entrance to Faldir's Cove, shattered ships rest beneath the waves. The Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine lie among them. Daggerspine naga dwell on the reef under Prince Nazjak's command. They seem able to command the bay's tides, and crews seeking shelter in the cove may be doomed by them.

sections.title: The Sunken City
sections.body: Deep beneath the reef lie the ruins of an ancient elven city. Dive among the drowned buildings, and calcified elven gems can still be found among the remains.

faq.answer: The Drowned Reef lies off the southern coast of the Arathi Highlands, just offshore from Faldir's Cove. Its waters endanger ships, while ancient ruins lie beneath the sea.

faq.q: Why are there so many sunken ships here?
faq.answer: Ships face danger in the waters off Arathi's southern coast. Daggerspine naga seem able to command the bay's tides, putting crews seeking refuge in Faldir's Cove at risk.
Daggerspine naga inhabit the Drowned Reef's flooded ruins under Prince Nazjak's command. They prey on stranded sailors and guard their submerged territory.

faq.q: What are the ruins submerged beneath the reef?
faq.answer: The ruins beneath the Drowned Reef belong to an ancient elven city. Calcified elven gems remain among its drowned buildings.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you may see the flooded halls and calcified gems as reminders of the Kaldorei empire. It shattered into the sea ten thousand years ago during the Great Sundering.
